reviews.title: Ads on games? Ridiculous!
reviews.text: I enjoy playing many of AARP's games, but I refuse to watch the intrusive, excessive ads that now come with them. Seems the addition of ads has screwed up the interface of the page, too, as it constantly jumps all over the place. Really stupid move, AARP. I pay for a membership, but I do NOT pay to be spammed with games.

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: I recently joined the AARP and I tried to install the app but it is faulty. Does not go beyond Enable Notifications and keeps jumping back to Enable Face Id.

reviews.title: You’ve ruined the app
reviews.text:
The most recent update to version 4.5.0 ruined the app. 
I’ve read the other reviews saying the same thing. Too many ads, keyboard not popping up in the app, too many BAD changes to the games etc. As an example, I used to play Mahjongg Solitaire almost daily. It’s unplayable now. The tiles are so small AND blurry. Does anyone at AARP even use this app? For older people (AARP’s target audience!) small and blurry is a no go. Different isn’t always better. And changing these games didn’t result in better functionality. Nope. The updates made everything worse. So I don’t know what your goal is with this app, but I for one will not be checking in daily like I used to. What a mess!
And I tried to find a way to send my feedback via the app but there’s no way to do it except through the AI chat bot. And the bot told me they couldn’t take my feedback and to try again Monday. Oh brother. 
You need to go back to the way the app used to be or you’ll continue to have unhappy customers.

reviews.title: Used to be good now horrible.
reviews.text: Used this app often in the past. I read the articles, stayed abreast of legislation affecting senior citizens, and played the games. The app no longer opens easily, requires me to log in (no Face ID recognition anymore) and the games are HORRIBLE. They make you wait for 1-2 minutes while the timer spins and then you have to watch 30-second ads re:  Chase, AARP, others. Then when I score high on games. points are Deducted (!) instead of added. The fitness sync to my Apple Watch no longer works. Won’t be using this app much now.

reviews.text: They are all too much and distracting from content. I also have to log in more than I’d like to view things.

reviews.title: Waste Of Time
reviews.text:
Earning points for doing a quiz is nice… until AARP continues to offer the same quiz to you everyday and after you finish ~ it tells you that you’re NOT eligible for points because you already took it. 
Plus, the screen repositions itself; creating an easy way for old people to make keystroke errors. All by design ~ they just want your attention and to waste your time here.

reviews.title: An absolute insult to senior citizens. Completely unusable.
reviews.text: For an organization that is supposed to advocate for older adults, AARP should be deeply embarrassed by this app. The design completely ignores basic accessibility standards.The text fields and password boxes are microscopic and incredibly frustrating to use. To make matters worse, if you try to increase your phone's system font size to actually see what you are doing, the app's poor scaling kicks in. The text boxes overlap, and the buttons get pushed completely off the screen, making it impossible to log in at all.You are forced to constantly log back in, only to fight with a broken interface that locks you out. The developers clearly did not test this app with real seniors. It is lazy, poorly coded, and a total piece of junk. Fix the scaling and make the font sizes readable!

reviews.title: Not good
reviews.text: The updates don’t allow users unable to afford newer phones to use the app so it’s useless to me. The updates will not allow use even if I go straight to the web site. 😔

reviews.title: Updated right out my iPad
reviews.text: Your upgrades have made your app useless on my iPad. And no options to choose a compatible version. I can't afford a new iPad. So I'll have to stop using AARP. Boo!

reviews.title: Not as Advertised
reviews.text: This app is not user friendly or easy to navigate. The pages take forever to load and often freeze the screen.  The print is very small which I find ironic as AARP is typically associated with Seniors in mind. The settings menu was incredibly difficult to find and upon arrival it would not allow me access to customization options. In frustration, I attempted to downloaded the app on my iPad. That experience was even worse as the app has frozen within the initial setup sequence and I can’t access it at all. I was looking forward to enjoying the additional benefits offered with my membership but I have only wasted an entire afternoon without any real progress. Unless the developers make additional improvements, I don’t recommend wasting your time or storage space on this app.

It keeps bugging the user to enter their phone number and says it is sending a code, but the code never arrives. Yes, I did double check my phone number was entered corrrectly.

reviews.title: Horrible over complication!

What should be a very simple process is made intentionally over complicated, and a major frustration! You have developed multiple applications with slightly different titles, which only adds to the confusion and unpleasant experience! 
Apparently, AARP Now, is the first place to go, but is almost impossible to locate! Why, the big secrets- be more forthcoming, and simplify the process and directions!

The other aspects of app seem functional. The informational articles can’t be beat.

reviews.title: Poor
reviews.text: While AARP claims to be a advocate for retirees and those of us who are older they create a app update that requires the latest smartphones and cannot be used for anything older. Not many of us (the people that they claim to care about) can afford to buy the latest phones. I have contacted AARP about this issue and have been just blown off.

reviews.title: Lousy App and poor interfaces
reviews.text:
This app is beyond low quality.  
1. I cannot use it in airplane mode.
2. The app wants to connect to the “mother ship”, all the time violating my privacy.
3. I cannot play games on it when my cellular data is off.  The games retain no memory if you want yo catch up later. Even free games apps,  keep up the memory, provide you opportunities for preventing ads. Unfortunately, the aarp app doesn’t allow any of that, despite sucking up membership dollars.
4. The app frequently logs me out, and after I log back in does not retain my settings, making me start all over again.
5. Many apps after you pay for services will not bother you with more advertising. Unlike them, even though one pays for AARP membership, the app strings in poor seniors who have already paid for AARP membership with more sucker ads. AARP is supposed to protect seniors from exploitation. Instead  in my mind the AARP app appears to exploit the very seniors it claims to respect and protect.
4.  App support is left to some stupid automatic response engine , whose responses leave the user frustrated.
Enuff said. AARP is designed to be exploitative (why peddle ads to members through games who have already paid) , and frankly frustrating.

reviews.title: Logs me out, not a good app
reviews.text: I’m new here.  I’m not impressed with the App at all.   It’s 2026, it should be better than this.  I’m 57 and reasonably tech savvy.  I wouldn’t recommend it to my parents.  Doesn’t even get the basic functionality down.  I reconfigured my dashboard to show what I want.  It reset to default.  I do the crosswords and by the time I finish (15-30 minutes) it logs me out so it doesn’t recognize which ones I’ve done.   It doesn’t recognize my login.  The website is a LITTLE better but not by much.

As some have already mentioned, with this latest update, many devices people own will no longer be compatible with the AARP app. If you knew and cared about your constituency, this would not have been allowed or tolerated!

reviews.title: UPDATE: The Latest Update Was a Downgrade
reviews.text:
4.12.26
AARP has jacked up the app again with their latest update. The app runs us in hamster circles just trying to get logged in. It constantly disconnects from my Apple Watch so I have to keep checking to see if it's synced or not. This has been an issue for a few years now and it has yet to be fixed.

1.23.25:
The issue with the watch no longer syncing with the app continues. Every month the reward section seems to go under an upgrade/maintenance which results in the watch being disconnected and login issues. You have to uninstall the app and start all over again. 🤷🏼‍♀️

11.1.24: 
The app keeps disconnecting from my Apple Watch which results in lost points. There's no warning or a heads up or anything on the app stating that it's no longer working. 🤷🏼‍♀️

10.7.24:
Here we are months later and the app still is so broken it's difficult to use. None of the issues that I noticed before have been fixed. We're talking at least three months now. You can't do anything with your points whatsoever on the app. At some point my watch was no longer synced with it. :(

Previous review:
The app has been pretty useless since the last update. None of the links work in the "More AARP" section which means you can't redeem your points without logging in on a PC and accessing it from there. This has been a problem for about two weeks and yet nothings been done to fix it. 🤷🏼‍♀️

reviews.title: Very Disappointed
reviews.text:
This app seems like it would have a lot of good content but it is so glitchy and slow!!! I’ve tried it on several different occasions months apart and it’s still the same. My phone is updated and I’m not iPhone illiterate. I know how to work it quite well. It constantly makes you sign in. It also takes you to the AARP website if you choose certain content. I wrote a comment and it would not even publish it. And it would not tell me why. I thought it was very bland and short. Nothing bad at all. lol! 
 Don’t waste your time with this app. You might want to just try the website instead if that even works. You would think after paying for membership that they would get the app right!! Disappointed!!

reviews.title: Awful
reviews.text: This is one of the worst apps I’ve ever tried to use. It runs me in circles on the login page, almost never actually letting me log in. None of the features actually work once I’m in the app. The games are static with no way to open them. The multitude of video ads just bog everything down, and seriously, why all the ads? I just subscribed! The website works almost as badly, even though I have cleared cache and changed browsers, and all the other suggestions I have found. Ultimately, you should not waste device space on this app. If you must access anything in your account, I recommend using the web version via Duck Duck Go which blocks the ads and allows the site to run a bit better. Just plain awful, and so is the AARP site.
